title: Zesty British Lamb Shepherds Pie
description: A pungent and light British dish featuring lamb and clotted cream, baked in a wood-fired ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onion until softened.
Add the lamb mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped carrot, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce, and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Stir in the clotted cream and season with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a ceramic tagine.
Top the lamb mixture with the mashed potato, spreading it evenly to cover.
Bake the shepherds pie in the preheated wood-fired oven for 30 minutes, or until the potato is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
